table:
| Coordinate | Stack Node | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| A0 | measurement-context | Capture event, actor, branch, and file-change context before running any enhancement. |
| B1 | risk-gate | Block secrets, risky workflow edits, and destructive shell patterns. |
| C2 | quality-stack | Run native lint, test, build, and syntax checks only when matching project files exist. |
| D3 | supply-chain-scan | Surface dependency and lockfile risk without creating recursive commits. |
| E4 | branch-advisor | Recommend the next branch/PR path without auto-merging. |
| F5 | evidence-report | Emit a single Markdown/JSON report artifact and optional PR comment. |
